name: First intro email
subject: Manpower support for {{company}}
body: Good day! I am {{rep}} from PrimePower Manpower Services. We supply trained janitorial, security, and production staff across NCR, Cebu, and Davao. May I schedule a 20-minute call this week to understand your headcount needs? Salamat!

name: Quotation follow-up
subject: Follow-up: quotation for {{company}}
body: Good day! Following up on the quotation we sent for your manpower requirement. Happy to adjust shifting schedules or rates. When is a good time for a quick call?

name: Discovery call script
subject: Discovery call
body: Ask: (1) current headcount by role, (2) shifting schedule, (3) pain points with current provider, (4) decision timeline, (5) billing contact. Outcome + next step required.

name: Site visit notes
subject: Site visit
body: Site: ___, Met with: ___, Headcount observed: ___, Shift pattern: ___, Issues: ___, Next step: ___.

name: Post-meeting thanks
subject: Thank you — next steps
body: Thank you for your time today! As discussed, our next step is ___. I will follow up by ___. Maraming salamat!
